title: עמק האלה — תפיסת תל עזקה
brief: כחול: תופס את תל עזקה מדרום. אדום: מחזיק בתל. אין בשטח מבנים — כל מחסה הוא מחסה של הקרקע.

window.place: Tel Azeka over the Elah valley (תל עזקה, עמק האלה): the tel stands at 345 m in the middle of the window, its eastern face falling 110 m to the valley floor, a ridge running south from it and low ground in the east.

about: A BLUE platoon taking the tel from the south, against a RED platoon holding
it. The ground here teaches the opposite half of what the Yokneam demo
teaches, and it teaches it with relief alone: this window holds one tree and
no buildings at all, so nothing is in cover that the shape of the hill does
not put there.
**The covered route is the expensive one.** The tel's eastern face is dead
ground — a force climbing it is unseen from the summit until it is 700 m in
— but it is a 110 m climb, and Naismith charges 8 m of the bound for every
metre of it (rules decision 15): 100 m of that face costs a squad between
250 and 360 m of its movement budget, which is five to seven turns of
walking. The southern ridge is the other way up: nearly level, so a bound
buys the distance it measures — and in view of the summit for its whole
length. The player is choosing between being seen and being slow, and the
map says which is which before a shot is fired: the drawn reach shrinks to
almost nothing pointed up the face.
The one piece of dead ground close in is the saddle at about (610, 450),
100 m below the summit and out of sight of every RED position — the only
place an assault can form up. Which is why RED has mined it.
RED's third squad sits on the northern spur watching the valley, the
approach BLUE has not taken. That is a third of the defence committed to
the wrong ground, and it is the only RED force that sees the valley floor —
so a feint east is worth something.

forces.name: כיתה 3
forces.note: The left-hand squad, from which the valley is reachable if the player would rather feint east than climb.

forces.name: מחלקה ב'/1
forces.note: On the summit: it sees the whole southern ridge and none of its own eastern face.

forces.name: מחלקה ב'/2
forces.note: On the shoulder above the ridge, in a position prepared before the battle: it covers the southern approach from 750 m in.

forces.name: מחלקה ב'/3
forces.note: On the northern spur, the only RED force that sees the valley floor — and, if BLUE comes up the ridge, the one watching the wrong ground.

forces.name: חפ"ק מ"מ
forces.note: Behind the summit, within 300 m of all three squads: this platoon is in contact every turn, which the attacker's will not be for long.
